extra.final_summary:
Average body mass by sex (after cleaning): female ≈ 3,733.7 g, male ≈ 4,550.9 g.

Data problems found and fixed:
- sex had a label variant "female " (trailing space, row 1); merged into "female" per the rules file.
- 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 30 and 32) were removed so penguins weren't double-counted.
- body_mass_g checked: fully numeric, no negatives, all values within the rules-file range 2500–6500 g.

Caveats: 1 row has a missing sex value (rules say missing means unknown, do not guess), so it is excluded from the averages — the results use 54 of 55 unique rows. The island column has a "Bisco" label (likely a misspelling of "Biscoe"), but it doesn't affect this question and was left unchanged.
